dct_title_s: Eastern Archipelago : Makassar Strait _ Celebes. Approaches to Makassar
dct_description_sm: From the latest Netherlands Government surveys.
Depths shown by soundings, relief by hachures and spot heights.
"Caution" note regarding innaccuracy of demarcated shoal water.
Shows depths, shoals, reefs, drainage, islands, peaks.
